data: Microsoft delivered a strong fiscal 2022, with revenue rising 18.0% to $198.3 billion from $168.1 billion in fiscal 2021. Gross profit climbed to $135.6 billion from $115.9 billion, for a fiscal 2022 gross margin of 68.4%. Operating income reached $83.4 billion versus $69.9 billion in fiscal 2021, equal to a fiscal 2022 operating margin of 42.1%. Profit growth slightly outpaced the top line. Net income grew 18.7% to $72.7 billion in fiscal 2022 from $61.3 billion in fiscal 2021, and diluted EPS rose to $9.65 from $8.05 per share. The company expanded earnings while investing more heavily: R&D expense increased to $24.5 billion in fiscal 2022 from $20.7 billion in fiscal 2021. High-teens growth, rich margins and rising R&D spending together suggest Microsoft can keep growing profits while funding future products.
